title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Planner agent in Microsoft 365 will help you plan, organize, and manage work more efficiently. We’re starting with core task and plan management features to simplify project tracking and will introduce additional advanced project management capabilities over time. Updated May 21, 2026: We previously launched in Preview and GA is expected in June. We apologize for any inconvenience.
